review.assessment: The change introduces a new `solution.py` containing a naive implementation of `parse_csv_line` that splits input solely on commas, ignoring all task requirements for quoted fields and escaped characters. This fails to parse standard CSV lines correctly, as it will split inside quotes and leave surrounding quote marks in the output. Consequently, any non-trivial CSV line with embedded commas or quotes will be tokenized incorrectly.

findings.defect: Quoted fields containing commas are incorrectly split into multiple fields.
Surrounding double quotes are not stripped from parsed fields.
Escaped double-quotes (""") are treated as separate tokens rather than a literal quote character within a field.
